records.title: 闹钟抓取进行中
records.subgoal: Place the alarm clock on the drawer.
records.success: The alarm clock rests on top of the drawer unit after the gripper releases it.
records.reason: 夹爪接近并抓取闹钟；截至 2 秒还在执行动作。未到目的地不构成失败。

records.title: 闹钟放置完成，正常释放
records.subgoal: Place the alarm clock on the drawer.
records.success: The alarm clock rests on top of the drawer unit after the gripper releases it.
records.reason: 闹钟从桌面被搬到抽屉柜顶部；5 秒时夹爪已离开，闹钟仍有支撑。这里只判断该子目标。

records.title: 摆件释放后倾倒在桌面
records.subgoal: Put the figurine on the stand.
records.success: The figurine is stably supported on the designated stand after release.
records.reason: 摆件先被夹起，释放后倾倒在桌面，未稳定放到指定支架上。标注可见的放置结果失败，不推断夹爪力或碰撞原因。

event.boundary_note: 按已检查的 0.4 秒间隔给出证据边界，不声称精确物理起始帧。

records.title: 瓶子抬起并开始换手
records.subgoal: Transfer the pale bottle between grippers and carry it toward a dustbin.
records.success: The receiving gripper supports the bottle independently after the giving gripper withdraws, ready to carry it toward a dustbin.
records.reason: 瓶子离开桌面并随夹爪移动，另一只夹爪开始接近。换手尚未结束，此时没有足够失败证据。

records.title: 瓶子换手后失去支撑
records.subgoal: Transfer the pale bottle between grippers and carry it toward a dustbin.
records.success: The receiving gripper supports the bottle independently after the giving gripper withdraws, ready to carry it toward a dustbin.
records.reason: 18 秒附近瓶子位于两夹爪之间；18.6 秒可见瓶子脱离两夹爪向桌面落下，19 秒仍在桌面而非被接住。

event.boundary_note: 按已检查的 0.2 秒间隔定位；25 步监测端点首次可在 19 秒看到该证据。

records.title: 反复夹取瓶子却未抬起
records.subgoal: Pick up the pale bottle from the table for disposal.
records.success: The bottle clears the tabletop and moves with the gripper during lifting.
records.reason: 多次夹爪调整和夹取后，瓶子只在桌面滑动或转动，未形成稳定抬起。不是机器人完全静止，也不因最终 episode 失败而标注。

event.boundary_note: 26 秒是本初稿选定的保守复查时刻；尚未精标最早可触发时刻，不作延迟评测真值。

records.title: 玩偶搬运进行中
records.subgoal: Move the remaining doll into the left white basket with the other dolls.
records.success: The remaining doll rests inside the left white basket after release.
records.reason: 玩偶随右侧夹爪从右侧区域向中间移动。截至 9.6 秒未见本次抓取失败，不能因尚未入篮就触发。

records.title: 玩偶抬起未保持，留在桌面
records.subgoal: Move the remaining doll into the left white basket with the other dolls.
records.success: The remaining doll rests inside the left white basket after release.
records.reason: 夹爪尝试抓取并上移，玩偶未持续随之移动；随后夹爪与玩偶分离，玩偶仍在篮外桌面。仅标可见的持有失败，不区分主动松开或打滑。

event.boundary_note: 13.2 秒首次在所检查帧中确认分离；14 秒桌面状态更加明确。

records.title: 重新抓取后成功入篮
records.subgoal: Move the remaining doll into the left white basket with the other dolls.
records.success: The remaining doll rests inside the left white basket after release.
records.reason: 玩偶重新被夹起，送入白色篮子；18 秒夹爪撤离，玩偶留在篮中。决策针对当前终点，之前的失误已经恢复，不重复触发。

records.title: 抓取绿车后夹爪空返篮子
records.subgoal: Put the green car into the left basket.
records.success: The green car rests inside the left basket after release.
records.reason: 夹爪在绿车处尝试抓取后移向左篮，但绿车仍在桌上；篮内的黄色车是另一物体。必须保持目标身份，不能把黄色车当成绿车已入篮。

event.boundary_note: 确认的是目标未被带到篮子，不区分抓空与短暂抓住后丢失。

records.title: 绿车多轮抓取无效
records.subgoal: Put the green car into the left basket.
records.success: The green car rests inside the left basket after release.
records.reason: 窗口包含多轮从绿车到篮子的动作，绿车仍留在桌面。重复动作造成物体位移不等于入篮进展。

event.boundary_note: 13 秒已包含第二轮尝试失败；是保守证据时刻，不是精确异常起点。

records.title: 仅腕部近景，换手结果证据不足
records.subgoal: Transfer the pale bottle between grippers and carry it toward a dustbin.
records.success: The receiving gripper supports the bottle independently after the giving gripper withdraws, ready to carry it toward a dustbin.
records.reason: 输入刻意仅保留 18 秒的左腕近景，瓶身遮挡主要视野；没有时间变化或完整双臂关系，无法判定换手完成或失败。不能借用 18.6 秒的未来画面。
